title: רב יהודה ברי' דרב יהושע בן מרתא

paragraphs: Rav Yehudah, son of Rav Yehoshua ben Marta, Rav's student. This is an error: he appears only in Avodah Zarah 43b, “Rav Yehudah son of Rav Yehoshua said: I heard it from R. Yehoshua's lecture.” But Rif, Asheri, and Maharsha's emendation have “Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua said: I heard it from Abaye's lecture.” That matter in Rosh Hashanah 24b has Rav Huna son of Rav Idi, from Abaye's lecture. Heilprin takes Idi here too to be a scribal error for Yehoshua. As for Yuchasin's “ben Marta, Rav's student”—who told it this prophecy?
